title: NextGI Perf with its 4 skinned characters, hardware ray tracing, Medium (Lite) (GS-7)

lines.name: Lite total on hardware ray tracing (Medium, irradiance field gather)
lines.reason: The GodotNext group is the NextGI frame block (nextgi_* without the closing marker's column and line 1b) plus skinned_refit_ms when a run has it: on frames with skinned BLAS work, line 1a's TLAS rebuild emits a Skinned refit timestamp inside the block, and that column, which then holds the TLAS build, has no nextgi_ prefix (the harness maps it to line 1a). The UE group takes every pass the captures show doing that work, by the lead's column rule (2026-11-16; plan §23.5 states it since v3.9.7, and the settings record does not list every column named here yet): for line 1a, GPU/RayTracingScene, the TLAS build (the settings record's skinned refit row names it from Epic's ray tracing performance guide); the Lumen scene update, GPU/LumenSceneUpdate and GPU/UpdateLumenSceneBuffers; and Lumen Lite's passes (below). The Medium capture shows no GPU/RayTracingDynamicGeometry although the same four characters are on the map, and GodotNext's line 1a still refits their BLAS, so the GodotNext side holds a refit the UE side does not show; the lead decides on it. Two busy columns stay out until the lead decides which GodotNext line, if any, does their work: GPU/NaniteRayTracing, busy in every hardware-tier capture and absent on the software tier, and GPU/DistanceFields, busy in every capture on both tiers and in the sets without Lumen. At Medium UE runs Lumen Lite: the game-mode captures on the RTX 4080 SUPER show GPU/LumenIrradianceFieldGather, while GPU/LumenScreenProbeGather and GPU/LumenReflections are absent or 0 (sg.ReflectionQuality 1 turns Lumen reflections off and GPU/ScreenSpaceReflections appears), so Lite's passes are the scene lighting and the irradiance field gather. UE takes the hardware tier from r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing 1, set per launch as the lead accepted on 2026-11-16, because the shared comparison project keeps Use Hardware Ray Tracing when available off.
